activity.title: The Box Tunnel
activity.goal: Move the whole body through, in, around and over things.
materials: A large cardboard box, staples taken out, edges taped
activity.safety: Take out every staple and tape the edges of the box. Keep both ends open and never close the flaps over a child. Use a soft floor, with the grown-up right beside the box. If there is an accident, call your local emergency number.
activity.forAdult: In the story, Mama Hedgehog looks under, behind and on things, and finds Little Hedgehog in the old boot. Small children get a feel for words like these when their own bodies go through, in, around and over things. Open both ends of a big cardboard box, take out every staple and tape the edges. Put a cushion beside it. Say one word at a time and do it with the child: “Through!” as they crawl through, “In!” as they sit inside, “Around!” as you walk round it together, “Over!” as they climb over the cushion. Say the word while the body moves, every time. Then hide a soft toy under, behind, on or in the box and ask “Where is Teddy?” To make it easier, use only “in” and “through”. To make it harder, let the child say the word while you do the moving. Five to ten minutes is plenty.
activity.inClass: Two or three boxes in a line make a little course on a soft floor, with one adult beside it and up to four children. One child goes at a time while the others wait their turn. The group calls each word together: “Through! In! Around! Over!”
